verdict.rationale: Yubico's FIDO2 documentation says the key requires user presence (a touch) and can optionally enforce user verification by PIN entry, so a stolen key alone cannot authenticate. The ykman CLI supports PIN management, and community users confirm setting a FIDO2 PIN. A community caveat is that keys ship without a PIN, so it must be set before enrolling. Missing for 10: any evidence of built-in biometric verification, in-depth first-party docs on FIDO2 PIN policy (retry limits, enforcing verification by default), and a way to require a PIN without re-enrolling keys already registered without one.
